name: paSSive poWer: a 3D 6K Experience
summary: A sensory & cerebral experience that aims to pull focus on the more subtle energies of human co-existence otherwise deemed as meekness. Or as award winning filmmaker / artist JB Ghuman, Jr. has dubbed them, the "paSSive poWers.” Combining breathing / chanting / movement  & more into a immersive cinematic experience. Shot on the incredible 11K Insta360 TITAN Camera. The film was originally a 4D experience where Ghuman traveled to over 5 countries & 17 Film Festivals, winning over 6 "BEST VR" awards.
